prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though home notification was underpredicted (+0.6% predicted vs +3.2% measured).
No clear effect was seen for home wait_info changes across 3 tests.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful in 1 winning test, though no clear effect was seen in 3 other tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (layout, new_screen, redesign), with only 1 test conducted each.
Evidence is still thin for finish changes (layout, copy, new_screen) and choose_path redesign (only 1 test conducted each).
Evidence is still thin for home notification changes (only 1 test conducted).

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Selection Overview Screen: Add an introduction screen prior to path selection to outline available pet paths before forcing a pick. (why: Choose path has a very high mean duration of 514s compared to an 8s median, indicating substantial user hesitation.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Summary Screen: Insert a quick pet interaction and control screen right before finalizing onboarding to explain pet visibility and control options. (why: Multiple post-onboarding support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Launch Diagnostic Flow: Introduce a desktop readiness checking screen during waiting to verify screen permissions before landing on home. (why: Support receives reports of pets not showing on the desktop or failing to render after finishing waiting.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Account Checklist Layout: Redesign the sign-in layout into a checklist format emphasizing account pet saving and profile protection. (why: The largest cluster of support emails (8 tickets) relates to lost pets or resets after re-authenticating.)
4: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Choice Cards Grid: Update the companion choice view to use prominent choice card components with distinct attribute badges. (why: Adoption dropoff is high at 60.9% conversion; clearer pet selection visuals lower friction.)
5: [finish, notification] Finish Screen Pet Activation Callout: Display a dynamic mascot launch notification badge on the home intro screen when onboarding completes. (why: Finish completion drops to 68.0% with users uncertain if the pet has successfully launched.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Fast Decision Copy: Simplify story text to highlight that path choices can easily be adjusted later. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is over 8 minutes (514s), pointing to excessive overthinking at step one.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Recovery Hint: Add an explicit safety hint detailing how existing pets are restored when using the correct login method. (why: Multiple users reported pet reset issues when signing back in with alternate emails or methods.)
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting Step Counter & Progress Indicator: Enable progress bar step counters and status updates during the pet setup wait screen. (why: Home stage median duration is 201s (mean 2336s), leading to user dropoff without active progress indication.)
